privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GomBrick ("the Service") is a personal, non-commercial database for organizing and browsing a Bearbrick collection. This page explains what information the Service collects, how it's used, and who it's shared with.
privacy.collect1: Google account info: when you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture from Google to create and identify your account.
privacy.collect2: Collection data: which bearbricks you've added to "My Collection", and an optional nickname/credit preference you set in your profile.
privacy.collect3: Content you submit: suggested bearbricks, edit requests, and photos you upload, along with the account that submitted them.
privacy.collect4: Usage data: pages visited and basic device/browser information, collected automatically via Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics.
privacy.use1: To sign you in, keep you signed in, and show your personal collection and profile.
privacy.use2: To let admins review and approve suggestions, edit requests, and submitted photos.
privacy.use3: To understand how the Service is used and improve it, using aggregated, non-identifying usage statistics.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: The Service relies on the following providers to operate:
privacy.thirdParty2: Vercel - hosting, file storage for uploaded photos, and analytics
privacy.thirdParty4: Each of these providers processes data under its own privacy policy.
privacy.noSale: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with third parties for their own advertising purposes.
privacy.retentionIntro: You can delete your account at any time directly within the GomBrick app.
privacy.retentionStep1: While signed in, tap the menu icon (☰) in the top-right corner.
privacy.retentionStep2: Tap your profile (the row showing your name and email) to open the Account screen.
privacy.retentionStep3: Tap "Delete Account" and confirm - your account is deleted immediately.
privacy.retentionDeleted: Deleted: your profile information (name, email, etc.), your Google sign-in link, login sessions, and your personal collection list. Deletion happens immediately, with no additional retention period.
privacy.retentionKept: Bearbrick entries and photos you contributed that were approved are part of the shared database other users see, so they are not deleted - only the author information is anonymized to "Deleted User".
privacy.retentionContact: If you can't access the app to delete your account yourself, contact us at the email below.
privacy.childrenBody: The Service is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy questions or data deletion requests, reach out at <email>my@favorite.kr</email>.
